title: Deal
description: One deals/<slug>.yaml file (#809): a time-limited DISCOUNT on a paid AI product, not a free offer. Deals live apart from offers/ and never count as free offers: they are excluded from the offer listing, search, counts, feed and offer pages, and appear only on /deals.html, deals/<slug>.html and in a separate `deals` section of index.json and the llms files, each entry marked kind: deal. A deal must end (expiry_date is required) and is hidden at build time once that day has passed. Free wording (see schemas/deal.rules.json) is rejected in every text field, and the keys amount / free / is_free are rejected outright. scripts/deal_model.py and app/scripts/load-deals.mjs enforce this schema plus the rules file; scripts/validate_offers.py cross-checks the enums.

title.description: Deal name as shown on cards, e.g. 'Example AI Pro — Black Friday'.

category.description: Deal scope: ai_subscription = AI chat assistant subscriptions; coding_agent = coding agents and AI IDEs; ai_tool_api = AI tools and APIs; agent_compute = sandboxes, cloud VMs and compute for agents. Anything else is out of scope and rejected.

discount.description: The discount exactly as the official page states it, e.g. '50% off the first year'.

regular_price.description: Optional: the regular price, only when the official page shows it.

deal_price.description: Optional: the discounted price, only when the official page shows it. Must contain a non-zero digit (a deal is never free).

promo_code.description: Optional: the code to enter at checkout. A code that names the deal free or 100% off (schemas/deal.rules.json promo_code_free_pattern, e.g. FREE50, 100OFF) is rejected; the match is strict, so FREEDOM50 is rejected too.

occasion.description: The sale event the deal belongs to (config/occasions.yaml names the windows).

start_date.description: Optional: first day of the deal, YYYY-MM-DD. Not after expiry_date. A future start_date is valid; the build hides the deal until that day.

expiry_date.description: Last day of the deal, YYYY-MM-DD. Required and never null: a deal must end. Hidden at build time from the next day on.

expiry_note.description: Optional: set when the official page states no end date and the occasion window end was used instead; says so in plain words.

source_url.description: The vendor's own page showing the discount (and its end date when stated).

verified_date.description: Day the deal was last checked on source_url, YYYY-MM-DD. Never in the future.

featured.description: Optional (#815): true pins the deal above the others on /deals.html (featured deals first, then the usual soonest-ending order) and shows a 'Featured' label on its card and page. Still a paid discount: never free wording, never counted as a free offer. Set only when Luong asks; the deal-hunter never sets it.

description.description: Optional: one or two sentences of terms quoted or closely paraphrased from the official page (who qualifies, which plan).
